exposure: residence in proximity to the hospital
mothers who delivered at younger than 21 years
cohort: 2109 neonates aged 28 days or less admitted to the pediatric ED
finding: Early postpartum discharge, out-of-hours ED presentation, neonatal age less than 7 days, residence in close proximity to the hospital, and primiparity were significantly associated with ED readmission within 24 hours.
mod_finding: The frequency of cesarean delivery among neonates admitted to the pediatric ED was 57.4%.
